source_instruction: what deodorants do you have that are alcohol free and very long lasting?
query: Ugh, I spent all last night binging that new coastal foraging documentary and now I can’t stop thinking about how to identify wild blackberries without mixing them up with the toxic lookalikes, plus I need to remember to pick up extra cat litter on my way home because my tabby keeps kicking half the current bag all over the laundry room floor, and I swear my neighbor’s lawn gnome moved three feet closer to my driveway overnight which is low-key stressing me out. Anyway, I’m browsing the deodorants & antiperspirants right now, can you help me find a good option that’s alcohol free and long lasting? I don’t want anything over a reasonable price, obviously.
